tips.text: Treat the milestone pick as final; there is no reroll, and Alt+F4 does not undo it.
Click the milestone icons under the login-day counter to preview what each upcoming milestone offers.
Pick Zenistar first only if you want it soonest; the order changes when you get each weapon, never whether.
Expect a duplicate at a later milestone if cross-save already gave you all four weapons.
Many players take Zenith first for use and keep Zenistar for the Mastery.
